body: EU and others rejected a final text that never mentioned fossil fuels. Kurum: decisions 'have not been adopted' — first no-deal summit since Copenhagen 2009.
headline: COP31 TALKS COLLAPSE: NO DEAL ADOPTED

body: Two tankers struck by projectiles off Khasab, a third burned on a mine; ~25 ships hit in seven days as Iran squeezes the oil chokepoint.
headline: TANKER WAR IN THE STRAIT OF HORMUZ

body: Ballistic missiles hit a restaurant car park, then jet drones struck rescuers twice more. Two dead, 73 injured; 25 blocks and a hospital damaged.
headline: TRIPLE-TAP STRIKE KILLS BOY, 7, AND PARAMEDIC

body: The sanctioned Sparta II, bound for Kaliningrad, was hit by two suspected Ukrainian drones; Finland warned the fire could rage for days.
headline: RUSSIAN ARMS SHIP ABLAZE IN THE BALTIC

body: Verstappen's third Vegas win in four years: 35 lead changes, Norris second, Piastri third; Russell hit the wall and fell to ninth.
headline: VERSTAPPEN WINS VEGAS GP BY 0.639s

body: Nasdaq -5.3%, S&P -3.7% into correction as the AI trade cracked; Nvidia -13.8% in a day, Anthropic's IPO fizzled near $83.
headline: AI ROUT WIPES OUT NASDAQ'S YEAR

body: Special forces backed by US intelligence seized Beltrán Leyva leader Fausto Meza Flores in Guasave; 11 died in the gunfight. Flown to Mexico City.
headline: FBI TOP-10 KINGPIN 'CHAPO ISIDRO' CAPTURED

body: M6.7 at 129 km depth: one dead, 16 injured, 853 displaced around Junín; Lima crowds fled cinemas. M5.0 aftershock Sunday.
headline: M6.7 QUAKE SHAKES PERU'S ANDES

body: Troops and the allied Joint Force recaptured Al-Khuway and cleared RSF positions around En Nahud and Abu Zabad, pushing toward Darfur.
headline: SUDAN ARMY RETAKES KEY TOWN FROM RSF

body: PAHO ruled measles endemic in the US after 26 years: 5,412 cases in 2026, most since 1991, 43 outbreaks, 96% unvaccinated.
headline: US LOSES MEASLES ELIMINATION STATUS

body: Suspected methanol liquor killed 16 and put ~600 in hospital in Chandel; six arrested, 2,419 litres seized in a statewide crackdown.
headline: TOXIC LIQUOR KILLS 16 IN MANIPUR

body: Flight PX19 shut down an engine on a fire warning and diverted to Davao; all 137 passengers and nine crew escaped down slides, unhurt.
headline: 146 SLIDE TO SAFETY AS 767 DIVERTS
